12 Entry Points

Broadcast

1. BBC Charter & Governance

BBC Charter renewal process, mid-term review, governance framework. BBC Board oversight, Royal Charter compliance, BBC Annual Report scrutiny, and editorial independence safeguards across all BBC services.

Regulation

2. Ofcom Broadcasting Regulation

Ofcom Broadcasting Code enforcement, content standards, and licensing. PSB prominence regime, EPG positioning, and on-demand regulation under the Media Act 2024.

Plurality

3. Media Plurality Framework

Media ownership rules, plurality test, and merger scrutiny. Cross-media ownership limits, local media market health, and news provider sustainability assessment across UK media landscape.

News

4. Local News Sustainability

Local Democracy Reporting Service, news publishers bargaining code, and BBC Local News Partnerships. Community journalism support, local news deserts mapping, and public interest journalism funding.

Streaming

5. On-Demand & Streaming Regulation

VoD regulation under Media Act 2024, prominence for PSB players, and audience protection. Netflix/Disney+/Amazon Prime compliance, age verification, and recommendation algorithm transparency.

Spectrum

6. Spectrum Management

Ofcom spectrum allocation, 5G/broadcasting coexistence, and digital switchover planning. Spectrum pricing, auction design, and interference management across UK broadcasting infrastructure.

AI

7. AI & Content Authenticity

Deepfake detection, AI-generated content labelling, and synthetic media regulation. Content provenance standards, watermarking requirements, and AI in news production guidelines.

Cultural

8. Cultural Heritage Media

BFI film preservation, National Archives broadcast collections, and cultural AI. Digital preservation standards, media heritage access, and AI-powered cultural cataloguing.

Sport

9. Sport Broadcasting Rights

Listed events regime, Crown Jewels protection, and sports rights market. PSB sport access, streaming platform competition, and anti-siphoning protections for major sporting events.

Digital

10. Digital Inclusion & Media Literacy

Media Literacy Strategy, digital skills programmes, and online safety education. Algorithmic literacy, critical thinking curricula, and vulnerable audience protection across all demographics.

Funding

11. Arts Council & Cultural Funding

Arts Council England funding, National Lottery distribution, and cultural investment. AI-assisted grant assessment, impact evaluation, and equitable funding distribution.

Accountability

12. Parliamentary & Public Accountability

DCMS Select Committee, BBC/Ofcom annual evidence sessions, and FOI. Public value test, charter renewal consultation, and audience trust monitoring.

Content compliance checking lag 30 days→real-time, Code breach detection +75%. AI-driven broadcast monitoring, automated harmful content flagging, and cross-platform standards consistency. Target: proactive compliance across all PSB and VoD platforms.

Plurality assessment 2 years→continuous, ownership tracking +95%. AI-powered media ownership mapping, cross-platform reach analysis, and editorial independence scoring. Target: real-time media plurality dashboard for Ofcom and DCMS.

VoD regulation compliance lag 6mo→1 month, prominence verification +80%. AI monitoring of PSB player positioning, age verification effectiveness, and recommendation algorithm transparency. Target: Media Act 2024 full compliance across all major platforms.

Deepfake detection accuracy 95%+, provenance verification latency <1hr. AI-powered content authentication, watermarking compliance checking, and synthetic media labelling enforcement. Target: UK global standard for trusted media content.

Spectrum allocation efficiency +35%, interference incidents −70%. AI-driven spectrum demand modelling, 5G/broadcasting coexistence planning, and dynamic spectrum sharing. Target: optimal UK spectrum utilisation across all broadcasting bands.

⛔ 6 Sovereign Red Lines

  • 🚫 No BBC editorial content altered, suppressed, or amplified by AI systems — editorial independence is a Royal Charter requirement and non-negotiable.
  • 🚫 No Ofcom enforcement data processed outside UK sovereign infrastructure — regulatory confidentiality and sub judice protections apply at all times.
  • 🚫 No media plurality intelligence used for political advantage — plurality assessments are Ofcom operational decisions requiring Board-level human authorisation.
  • 🚫 No sports broadcasting rights data shared with streaming platforms or rights holders — Crown Jewels list and anti-siphoning protections require Ministerial clearance.
  • 🚫 No AI-generated content published on PSB platforms without human editorial sign-off and clear synthetic content labelling per Ofcom Broadcasting Code Section 5.
  • 🚫 No local news funding allocation adjusted by AI without Local News Fund Panel human approval and DCMS Minister sign-off for allocations over £100K.

5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery
Map DCMS estate — BBC policy unit, Ofcom liaison, media plurality team, streaming regulation, spectrum policy, cultural heritage, sport broadcasting, digital inclusion. Identify AI-ready processes and sovereignty constraints.
2
Governance Design
Deploy DORADO patterns — editorial independence firewalls, content classification safeguards, Ofcom regulatory boundaries. Align with Article 50, BBC Royal Charter, Broadcasting Act 1990/1996, and Media Act 2024.
3
Pilot
Launch controlled pilots in charter evidence compilation, content standards monitoring, and local news mapping. Measure against KPIs: charter renewal preparation time, Ofcom breach detection rate, local news desert reduction.
4
Scale
Roll out proven MCPs across DCMS, Ofcom, BBC governance, BFI, and Arts Council. Integrate with Ofcom Broadcast Bulletin, BBC Annual Report, and cultural heritage archives. Deploy sovereign OWEM adapters for media governance.
5
Assure
Continuous sovereignty verification — editorial independence, regulatory confidentiality, cultural heritage preservation. DCMS Select Committee reporting, Ofcom Board oversight, and public trust monitoring.
